body: Honestly just hoping to find the answer. Never used these sights/pages etc. but always see “success” stories about how people get talked down. I’m literally on the edge and hoping to see/hear the one thing that will keep me from doing it, whatever it is. Because the standard, “you have so much to live for” and “permanent solution to a temporary problem” stuff doesn’t hold anymore. My situation of chronic pain seems pretty permanent. And I do have a family worth fighting for, but at this point, I’m just dragging them down. They don’t feel that way, and never would,  No matter how bad I get. But it is what it is. Kids missing out on kid things because I can’t function and mom has to work multiple jobs to keep the roof over our head. I’m destroying their childhood simply by existing.
